dct_title_s: Morrison Park and Washburn Fair Oaks General Plans, Minneapolis Park Board, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: Lantern slide image of a map of a colorized general suggestive plan for the improvement of Dorilus Morrison Park and Washburn Fair Oaks in connection with the Minneapolis Institute of Arts created April 18, 1914.
